actions.opportunity_summary: AJ could act as a connective strategist across ambiguous client mandates: translating AI ambition into teachable methods, linking education and future-of-work themes to enterprise transformation, and helping Futurice incubate cross-sector propositions beyond one-off projects.
why_recommended: Company intelligence brief is available to ground outreach.
Intelligence entry points suggest a concrete collaboration path.

email.subject: Harri Kiljander — opportunity to explore Innovation Partner in Residence with Futurice
email.body:
Hello Harri Kiljander,

I have been following Futurice's work — Futurice is a European digital innovation and software consultancy. It helps organizations design, build, and scale digital products and services, with studios across Finland, Germ.

I would like to explore advisory support around innovation partner in residence and how AJ can help connect product, AI, and organizational change.

My background spans systems thinking, product strategy, ai transformation, innovation, and I am especially interested in founder-led environments where multipotentialite operators can connect ideas, products, and systems.

Would you be open to a short conversation?

Best,
Ankit
